backend/main.mo: Actor managing tracks, playlists, user profiles, background GIFs, and access‑controlled media operations with storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping AirPlay-related features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing functionality of various frontend components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry for the PWA including meta tags, manifest, and root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, theme colors, start URL, and icons.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app handling authentication, admin session restoration, GIF initialization, and transitions between player and dashboard.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistDia: Dialog allowing single or multiple tracks to be added to one or more playlists with batch logic and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/AirPlayControl.t: AirPlay control button showing support, availability, and connection state with optional compact mode and tooltip.
frontend/src/components/AirPlayPlaybackA: Displays an alert for AirPlay playback issues with a retry button and loading state.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundGifOve: Shows a fading, randomized background GIF during playback based on user settings and track changes.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundVisual: Provides UI to upload, delete, preview, and configure background GIF settings with error handling and retries.
frontend/src/components/BatchEditTrackDi: Dialog for batch‑editing track metadata with field selection, validation, and bulk update submission.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistFo: Form to create playlists by uploading tracks, extracting metadata, and managing upload progress and errors.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistFr: Dialog to create a playlist from existing library tracks with search, selection, and playlist ID input.
frontend/src/components/CyberpunkBackgro: Animated cyberpunk canvas background with particles, flares, beams, and parallax, reactive to audio data.
frontend/src/components/DJAuthModal.tsx: Modal handling Internet Identity login flow with session checking, success/error toasts, and retry logic.
frontend/src/components/DJDashboard.tsx: Admin-only DJ dashboard showing playlists and media tools with logout handling and static background.
Dialog for editing track metadata with form fields, validation, and update mutation.
frontend/src/components/EmbeddedMusicPla: Full music player with playlist selection, adaptive buffering, AirPlay support, and audio-reactive data.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Fullscreen neon loading screen with animated logo and pulsing indicators.
frontend/src/components/MediaLibrary.tsx: Displays and manages the media library with search, sorting, selection, editing, deletion, and playlist actions for tracks.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploadDialo: Handles selecting, metadata extraction, progress tracking, and uploading of audio files to the backend.
frontend/src/components/PlaylistList.tsx: Renders a list of playlists with their tracks, showing basic track metadata and durations.
Provides a tabbed interface for creating playlists, viewing playlists, browsing the media library, using the music player, and managing visuals.
frontend/src/components/RadioPlayer.tsx: Implements a streaming radio player with playlist selection, play/pause control, listener sessions, buffering logic, AirPlay support, and audio analysis.
frontend/src/components/StreamStabilityI: Shows a visual indicator of stream stability with different colors and labels for stable, buffering, or error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAirPlay.ts: Hook detecting AirPlay support, availability, connection changes, and exposing a picker trigger.
frontend/src/hooks/useAirPlayPlaybackRec: Hook that restores audio playback after AirPlay route changes by reloading and resuming the track.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioAnalyzer.ts: Hook creating an audio analyzer with frequency-band metrics, adaptive throttling, and visual analysis data updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for playlists, listener counts, background assets, and authenticated mutations using canister actors.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus a neon-themed color system and custom glow/animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry mounting React with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/types/airplay.d.ts: Type declarations for Safari-specific AirPlay media APIs and related events.
frontend/src/utils/airplayBufferingStrat: Defines AirPlay and default buffering configs and helpers to determine recovery timing and buffer thresholds.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL params, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from the URL/hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, containers, and theming with plugins.
project_state.json: JSON describing the project’s current feature set, versions, and high-level app summary.
